archetype: 5 (Luxury / Cinematic Fusion with Organic Japanese aesthetics)

layout.spacingScale: Generous spacing. Use p-8, p-12, p-24 for sections. High negative space.
layout.borderRadius: rounded-sm (2px) to rounded-md (6px) for a sharper, cinematic luxury feel. Avoid pill shapes.
layout.gridStrategy: Mode A: 'Tetris' Grid for Marketing (Asymmetry). Mode B: 'Control Room' for Dashboard map UI.

surfaces.cards: bg-[#121620] border border-white/5 hover:-translate-y-1 hover:border-white/20 transition-all duration-300
surfaces.mapOverlay: Crystal glass styling to float above the map without obscuring it.

components.hero: Max overlay opacity bg-black/40. Cinematic full-height image. Large Cormorant Garamond heading, left-aligned, overlapping.
components.buttons: Primary: Solid #E14D45 with #F8FAFC text, hover:bg-[#F96058]. Secondary: Glassmorphism or transparent with border-white/20 hover:bg-white/10.
components.chatInterface: Minimalist sidebar for character chat. Messages use soft pastel bubbles (Sakura for Frieren, Mystic Blue for Gojo) on deep background.
components.icons: Use lucide-react with strokeWidth={1.5} for thin, elegant strokes.

motion.hover: Subtle lifts (-translate-y-1) and inner border glows. No aggressive scaling.
motion.scroll: Smooth scroll (Lenis) with parallax background imagery.

hero_background.description: Sunset pagoda overlooking Kyoto. Use as the main landing page cinematic hero background.

tokyo_night.description: Rainy neon Tokyo street. Use for urban/modern anime location cards (e.g., Jujutsu Kaisen, Your Name vibes).

mount_fuji.description: Mount Fuji with cherry blossoms. Use for peaceful/scenic location cards (e.g., Frieren, Demon Slayer vibes).

shrine_silhouette.description: Pagoda silhouette. Great for a section background with parallax effect.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use pure HTML/Tailwind for the landing page to achieve an asymmetrical, overlapping 'Tetris' grid.
For the dashboard/map/trip planner, use Shadcn UI with 'Control Room' density, customized to the dark luxury theme (no rounded pills, use sharp/sm borders).
Always apply data-testid to interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='generate-trip-button').
Implement an interactive map (Leaflet) inside a glassmorphic container or as a full-bleed background with glass floating panels.
Ensure dark mode is forced. The palette is specifically designed for a cinematic dark theme.
Do not use generic blue/purple tech gradients. Use textured dark backgrounds with subtle, soft, warm lighting (Sakura/Vermillion glow).
Add font imports to index.css or layout.
